concerns.text: T070 (Fix Data Flow Dependency) depends on T011a-1b (Graph Serialization), but T011a-1b is located in Phase 3 (User Story 1). A foundational fix for the data flow cannot logically depend on a user-story task that hasn't been defined yet. T070 must be moved to Phase 2 and depend only on Phase 1 setup tasks, or T011a-1b must be moved to Phase 2.

T077 (Streaming Loader Fallback) depends on T036-NEW (In-Memory Data Loader). T036-NEW is marked as incomplete `[ ]` in Phase 2. While T077 is in Phase 2, it cannot be executed or validated until T036-NEW is implemented. This creates a blocking dependency within the same phase that prevents the 'Foundation ready' checkpoint from being reached.

T011a-1b-serialize depends on T011a-1a (Extract Triples) and T011a (Download). However, T011a-1a depends on T011a-3 (spaCy Model) which is in Phase 1. The chain is valid, but T011a-1b-serialize also lists T011a-1b-validate as a dependency. T011a-1b-validate is a test task that validates the output of T011a-1b-serialize. A task cannot depend on its own validation test for execution; the test should depend on the task, not vice versa. This creates a circular or inverted dependency.

T011c (Generate Noisy Graph) depends on T011a-1b-validate. As noted above, a production task (T011c) should not depend on a validation test task (T011a-1b-validate) for its execution logic. It should depend on the artifact producer (T011a-1b-serialize). The test should run after T011c or in parallel, but not block the generation of the noisy graph.

T024a (Statistical Analysis Clean) depends on T013 (Baseline Runner) and T019a/b (Heuristic Runners). T019a and T019b are marked as `[~]` (rejected/incomplete) in Phase 4. T024a cannot proceed until the heuristic results are generated. This is a valid dependency, but the status of T019a/b blocks the entire Phase 5. The ordering is correct, but the state of the upstream tasks prevents progress.

T011a-1b-serialize lists T011a-1b-validate as a dependency. This is likely a typo for T011a-1b-serialize depending on T011a-1a. The validation task (T011a-1b-validate) should depend on T011a-1b-serialize, not the other way around. This is a semantic inversion of the producer-consumer relationship.
